provenance.primary-source: packages/core/src/combo-box/{ComboBox.tsx,useComboBox.ts} for the trigger and selection model; packages/core/src/pill-input/{PillInput.tsx,PillInput.css} for the editable field chassis; packages/core/src/option/{Option.tsx,Option.css,OptionList.tsx,OptionList.css,OptionGroup.tsx,OptionGroup.css} for the popup and its contents — the IDENTICAL shared components select.salt.json already extracted, confirmed by import path (ComboBox.tsx: `import { OptionList } from "../option/OptionList"`, the literal same module Dropdown.tsx imports). Every style.popup.*/style.option.*/style.group-label.*/style.group.border-top/style.separator value below is REUSED VERBATIM from select.salt.json rather than re-derived — see COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md Finding 1.
provenance.field-bg / field-bg-secondary / field-bg: PillInput.css .saltPillInput-{primary,secondary,tertiary} { --pillInput-background: var(--salt-editable-{variant}-background) } — the IDENTICAL token chain Dropdown.css uses for its own --dropdown-background, so the resolved colours are identical to select.salt.json's own field-bg family.
provenance.field-bg-*-disabled: --pillInput-background-disabled (secondary/tertiary blocks only set this key; primary's disabled state is read via .saltPillInput-disabled's OWN --pillInput-background-disabled fallback) -> editable-{variant}-background-disabled, identical resolution to select.
provenance.field-bg-readonly: --pillInput-background-readonly -> editable-background-readonly -> --salt-color-transparent, identical to select's own readonly background.
provenance.fg / fg-disabled: PillInput.css: color: var(--saltPillInput-color, var(--salt-content-primary-foreground)); .saltPillInput-disabled sets color: var(--saltPillInput-color-disabled, var(--salt-content-primary-foreground-disabled)) -> black-40a / white-40a. Identical to select's own fg family.
provenance.fg-secondary: PillInput.css .saltPillInput-input::placeholder { color: var(--salt-content-secondary-foreground); font-weight: var(--salt-text-fontWeight-small) } — the SAME token select's own placeholder and group-label rows use.
provenance.border / border-hover / border-active: .saltPillInput-primary { --pillInput-borderColor: var(--salt-editable-borderColor); --pillInput-borderColor-hover: var(--salt-editable-borderColor-hover); --pillInput-borderColor-active: var(--salt-editable-borderColor-active) } — the IDENTICAL token chain Dropdown.css uses, so the resolved colours are identical to select's own border family.
provenance.border-readonly / border-disabled: .saltPillInput-bordered.saltPillInput-readOnly/-disabled hang these off CLASSES here (not the [aria-readonly]/:disabled attribute/pseudo-class Dropdown.css uses) but resolve through the identical editable-borderColor-readonly/-disabled tokens.
provenance.accent / accent-weakest / accent-weaker: IDENTICAL to select's own — OptionList/Option are the same shared components.
provenance.status-*: PillInput.css .saltPillInput-{error,warning,success} { --pillInput-borderColor/-borderColor-active/-borderColor-hover/-outlineColor: var(--salt-status-{s}-borderColor); --pillInput-background/-background-readonly: var(--salt-status-{s}-background) } — the IDENTICAL token chain Dropdown.css uses. Note PillInput's status blocks additionally reassign background-readonly directly (Dropdown's own status blocks do this too, matching select.salt.json's own style.trigger.status@error cell).
provenance.popup-bg / popup-shadow / separator-colo: IDENTICAL to select.salt.json's own values — same OptionList.css/OptionGroup.css source files, same shared components.
provenance.byDensity.control-height: PillInput.css min-height: var(--saltPillInput-minHeight, var(--salt-size-base)) -> 20/28/36/44px, identical to select's own field, though note PillInput ALSO sets a min-width default of 4em inline (--saltPillInput-minWidth) unlike Dropdown, which hardcodes it as a bare literal — same resolved value, different override mechanism.
provenance.byDensity.field-padding: PillInput.css padding-left/-right: var(--saltPillInput-paddingLeft/-paddingRight, var(--salt-spacing-100)) — identical zero-vertical-padding shape to select's trigger.
provenance.byDensity.trigger-gap: PillInput.css .saltPillInput-inputWrapper { gap: var(--salt-spacing-50) } — HALF select's own field-gap (spacing-100). A real, sourced divergence between the two Salt trigger chassis: PillInput's internal wrapper (holding pills + the input) uses the half-step spacing scale, where Dropdown's trigger content uses the full step. spacing-50 = half of spacing-100 (foundations/spacing.md's own halving relationship, the same relationship spacing-25 = quarter already established for select's own option-padding formula) -> 2/4/6/8px by density.
provenance.byDensity.corner-weak / popup-corner / t: IDENTICAL to select.salt.json's own byDensity values — PillInput.css's own border-radius: var(--salt-palette-corner-weak, 0) matches Dropdown.css exactly, and every option/group/icon value is read from the SAME shared Option/OptionGroup/Icon files select already extracted.
provenance.combobox-trigger-width: Renamed slot for the same inline mechanism select's own popup-min-width uses (ComboBox.tsx's floating-ui size() middleware writes --overlay-minWidth = the trigger's own measured width, read by OptionList.css as min-width). The skeleton measures the trigger field and sets --combobox-trigger-width inline on the popup; this slot carries only the 0px fallback, per the SAME fix select.salt.json's own popup-min-width provenance entry documents (a var() inside a custom-property declaration resolves where it is DECLARED, not where it is used).
provenance.aria: trigger input: role={readOnly?"textbox":"combobox"} (see COMBOBOX-MATRIX.md Finding 6 — this role FLIPS, unlike select's trigger which stays role="combobox" regardless of readOnly), aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, aria-controls (only while open), aria-readonly (only when readOnly). Popup: role="listbox" on the FloatingComponent. Option: role="option", aria-selected, aria-disabled, tabIndex={-1} — identical to select's own aria shape.
